### Proposed RFC / Pull Request Details

* **Type:** [RFC Proposal / Bug Fix / Feature / Documentation]
* **RFC Number (if applicable):** [e.g. 0002]
* **Title:** [e.g. RFC 0002: Speed Duel 3-Zone Coordinate Extension]
* **Author(s):** [@handle]

---

### RFC Checklist (for RFC Proposals)
- [ ] Created from `rfcs/0000-template.md`.
- [ ] Assigned the next sequential RFC number.
- [ ] Fully documents **Motivation**, **Detailed Design**, **Drawbacks & Edge Cases**, **Prior Art**, and **Unresolved Questions**.
- [ ] Includes concrete side-by-side examples before and after the change.
- [ ] Verified locally with `npm run rfc:lint`.
- [ ] Does not break backward compatibility with YGN v1.0 / v1.1 without an explicit deprecation timeline.
- [ ] Added or updated test fixtures under `fixtures/`.

---

### Code & Implementation Verification
- [ ] TypeScript compiles cleanly: `npm run build`
- [ ] TypeScript & Lua tests pass: `npm test`
- [ ] Python reference tests pass: `npm run test:py`
